name: Elin Rhys
bio:
Elin Rhys discovered her passion for motorsport while helping her father restore classic cars in their garage in rural Wales. She was immediately drawn to the intricate details and the challenge of creating something both beautiful and functional. This passion led her to pursue a degree in motorsport engineering, where she specialized in composite materials. After graduating, Elin gained valuable experience working with several smaller racing teams before joining Boutsen VDS.

As a composite technician, Elin is meticulous and dedicated. She approaches each project with a focus on precision and quality, understanding that even the smallest imperfection can have a significant impact on performance. She is a strong believer in continuous learning and is always seeking new ways to improve her skills and knowledge. Elin's loyalty to her team and unwavering commitment to excellence make her a valuable asset to Boutsen VDS.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elin is of average height with a lean build, and her hands are often stained with carbon fiber dust.

quirks: Always listens to Welsh folk music through headphones while working.
Has a small collection of vintage motorsport patches on her workbench.
Meticulously cleans her tools at the end of each shift, regardless of how tired she is.
